review: Independent agent engineering review; simulated identities, no practitioner or real Auth0 verification
expectations: A request uses only its own verified Convex identity; a different allowlisted subject cannot reuse another subject's cookie or in-flight response.
Allowlist removal or backend seat revocation prevents the next action; logout invalidates current cookie and aborts old UI work.
Invoice evidence cannot establish its own trusted contact; a bank change must use the existing approved contact and separate verifier/approver.
A supplier proposal verified under authority subsequently revoked must not gain bank authority without current valid verification.
Sequential quorum cannot be skipped, filled twice by one principal, or finalized using revoked or expired delegation.
Accepting one of two 3850-cent units recognizes3850, retains original7700 and disputed3850, creates one journal and no payment.
Identical original PO/receipt/return bytes cannot acquire new economic capacity by renaming source or parser-assigned line IDs.
Tax/cost credits must reverse exact remaining original allocations, never reuse returned units, and cannot mutate a reserved original obligation.

Before possible send a supplier change invalidates authority and requires recertification and renewed payment approval; after possible send the original key/destination/reservation must survive recovery.
QBO business sync and B4 are separate gates; no baseline expansion or provider calls.
